name: Rubikc
description:
Rubikc turns your Shopify catalog into a fast, swipeable storefront shoppers actually want to browse. This connector links Claude to your Rubikc admin so you can check performance and adjust merchandising without opening a separate dashboard.

Ask how a Space (your storefront) is doing: sessions, swipe engagement, traffic quality, and which cubes (product or content feeds) are working. Then update cubes, blocks, shared blocks, navigation, and structures in plain language. Changes go through your Rubikc account with the same permissions you already use in admin.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rubikc to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rubikc to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api2.rubikc.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rubikc MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rubikc lists 24 MCP tools, including analyzeCubes, analyzeStorefront, getCubePlaybook, getMcpStatus, getOnboardingContext, getStorefrontContentPlaybook, getStorefrontMap, inspectSessions, inspectSurveys, instructions, listStorefronts, and manageCubeContent.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rubikc?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Rubikc in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Rubikc requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rubikc is developed by Rubikc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
